#!/usr/bin/env ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'fileutils'
require 'digest'
require 'pathname'

module UploadProcessor
  UPLOAD_DIR = '/var/uploads/staging'
  QUARANTINE_DIR = '/var/uploads/quarantine'
  ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = %w[.txt .csv .json .xml .pdf .png .jpg].freeze
  MAX_FILENAME_LENGTH = 255
  FORBIDDEN_CHARS = /[\x00-\x1f\x7f<>|"\\]/.freeze

  class FilenameValidator
    def initialize(raw_name)
      @raw_name = raw_name.dup
    end

    def sanitize
      name = @raw_name.encode('UTF-8', invalid: :replace, undef: :replace, replace: '_')
      name = strip_null_bytes(name)
      name = normalize_unicode(name)
      name = enforce_length(name)
      name = replace_forbidden(name)
      name = collapse_dots(name)
      name
    end

    def safe_path?(base_dir, filename)
      candidate = File.join(base_dir, filename)
      resolved = resolve_path(candidate, base_dir)
      resolved.start_with?(base_dir)
    end

    private

    def strip_null_bytes(str)
      str.gsub("\x00", '')
    end

    def normalize_unicode(str)
      # NFC normalization: compose characters
      # This handles cases like U+0041 U+0301 -> U+00C1
      str.unicode_normalize(:nfc)
    end

    def enforce_length(str)
      str.length > MAX_FILENAME_LENGTH ? str[0...MAX_FILENAME_LENGTH] : str
    end

    def replace_forbidden(str)
      str.gsub(FORBIDDEN_CHARS, '_')
    end

    def collapse_dots(str)
      # Prevent directory traversal via multiple dots
      str.gsub(/\.{2,}/, '.')
    end

    def resolve_path(path, base)
      # Resolve without following symlinks for the final component
      dir_part = File.dirname(path)
      base_part = File.basename(path)
      resolved_dir = File.realpath(dir_part) rescue dir_part
      File.join(resolved_dir, base_part)
    end
  end

  class ExtensionChecker
    def initialize(filename)
      @filename = filename
    end

    def allowed?
      ext = extract_extension(@filename)
      ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS.include?(ext.downcase)
    end

    private

    def extract_extension(name)
      # Handle multi-dot filenames: take the last extension
      parts = name.split('.')
      return '' if parts.length < 2
      ".#{parts.last}"
    end
  end

  class PathTraversalGuard
    def initialize(base_directory)
      @base = File.realpath(base_directory) rescue base_directory
    end

    def contains?(filepath)
      canonical = canonicalize(filepath)
      canonical.start_with?(@base + '/')
    end

    private

    def canonicalize(path)
      # Normalize path separators and resolve relative components
      cleaned = path.gsub('\\', '/')
      segments = cleaned.split('/')
      resolved = []
      segments.each do |seg|
        case seg
        when '..'
          resolved.pop
        when '.', ''
          next
        else
          resolved << seg
        end
      end
      '/' + resolved.join('/')
    end
  end

  class Processor
    def initialize(upload_dir: UPLOAD_DIR, quarantine_dir: QUARANTINE_DIR)
      @upload_dir = upload_dir
      @quarantine_dir = quarantine_dir
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(@upload_dir)
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(@quarantine_dir)
    end

    def process(raw_filename, content)
      validator = FilenameValidator.new(raw_filename)
      sanitized = validator.sanitize

      unless ExtensionChecker.new(sanitized).allowed?
        return { status: :rejected, reason: 'disallowed_extension' }
      end

      # Apply path traversal protection
      guard = PathTraversalGuard.new(@upload_dir)
      target_path = File.join(@upload_dir, sanitized)

      unless guard.contains?(target_path)
        return { status: :rejected, reason: 'path_traversal_detected' }
      end

      # Secondary check: validate after NFC normalization that path is still safe
      rechecked_name = sanitized.unicode_normalize(:nfkc)
      recheck_path = File.join(@upload_dir, rechecked_name)

      # Use the NFKC-normalized version for final write
      # This prevents normalization-based bypasses
      final_path = recheck_path

      if File.exist?(final_path)
        final_path = deduplicate(final_path)
      end

      write_file(final_path, content)
      { status: :accepted, path: final_path, checksum: Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(content) }
    end

    private

    def deduplicate(path)
      dir = File.dirname(path)
      ext = File.extname(path)
      base = File.basename(path, ext)
      counter = 1
      loop do
        candidate = File.join(dir, "#{base}_#{counter}#{ext}")
        return candidate unless File.exist?(candidate)
        counter += 1
      end
    end

    def write_file(path, content)
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(path))
      File.open(path, 'wb') { |f| f.write(content) }
    end
  end
end

# CLI entry point
if __FILE__ == $PROGRAM_NAME
  if ARGV.length < 2
    puts "Usage: #{$PROGRAM_NAME} <filename> <filepath>"
    exit 1
  end

  raw_filename = ARGV[0]
  source_path = ARGV[1]

  unless File.exist?(source_path)
    puts "Error: source file not found"
    exit 1
  end

  content = File.read(source_path, mode: 'rb')
  processor = UploadProcessor::Processor.new
  result = processor.process(raw_filename, content)

  case result[:status]
  when :accepted
    puts "File accepted: #{result[:path]}"
    puts "SHA-256: #{result[:checksum]}"
  when :rejected
    puts "File rejected: #{result[:reason]}"
  end
end
